raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

DeepSeek-V4.1 decodes garbage on ROCm GPUs other than gfx942/gfx950. Prefill is fine. Tested on gfx1151.

#57435 folded the inverse RoPE into the split-K sparse decode reduce, and `rocm_sparse_attn_decode` returns how many rows it already rotated so the caller can skip them. But only gfx942/gfx950 run that split-K reduce. Every other arch takes the fallback kernel, which never applies the inverse RoPE, yet the function still reports every row as rotated. Those rows never get rotated.

This PR fixes the return value at the source: rows count as rotated only when the split-K reduce folded the RoPE. Nothing changes on gfx942/gfx950.

#52970 and #58800 avoid the bug in DeepSeek-V4's model by not requesting the fused RoPE there. DeepSeek-V4.1 has no such check and is still broken on main. With the kernel fixed, this PR removes both checks.

## Duplicate-work check

Searched open PRs for `rocm_sparse_attn_decode` and `inv_rope_positions`. No duplicate. #52970 and #58800 (both merged) avoid the bug in DeepSeek-V4's model only; this PR replaces their checks. #60154 (merged) and #61967 change the gfx942/gfx950 decode paths, not this return value.

## Test Result

All on gfx1151, greedy, `--enforce-eager`.

**On main @ 3a228c1fe**

```
pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_triton_attn_dsv4.py   67 passed, 74 skipped
mypy (pre-commit hook)                                          no issues
```

GSM8K, all 1319 questions, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` (TP=4 over 4× gfx1151):

```
|Tasks|n-shot|      Filter       |  Metric   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|-----:|-------------------|-----------|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|     0|#### or last number|exact_match|0.9575|±  |0.0056|
```

**Before / after, on main @ 39983a5e7 (before #52970)**

```
                                                 before                after
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP=4), 5 checkable prompts  5/5                   5/5
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (TP=4), GSM8K first 25       1/25                  25/25
DeepSeek-V4-Flash (TP=2), 5 checkable prompts    1/5                   5/5
DeepSeek-V4-Flash (TP=2), GSM8K first 25         -                     25/25
```

DeepSeek-V4-Flash, "What is the capital of France?":

```
before -> We need answer (1) \n"**） * ... (so Paris</think> ** ( ) ) **
after  -> We need answer simple. Capital of France is Paris. One short sentence.</think>The capital of France is Paris.
```

## AI assistance

AI assistance was used for this change. The submitting human has reviewed every changed line and ran the tests reported above.

 ) -> int:
     """Run sparse MLA decode into ``output``.
 
-    Passing ``inv_rope_positions`` folds the inverse RoPE into the reduce
-    epilogue. Returns how many leading rows of ``output`` came back rotated,

+    fallback kernel on other GPUs ignores the positions. Returns how many
+    leading rows of ``output`` came back rotated (every row when the reduce
+    folded the RoPE, 0 otherwise), so the caller knows which rows still owe
+    the standalone pass. Read it from the eager attention segment only.

@@ -4887,7 +4889,10 @@ def rocm_sparse_attn_decode(

+    fused_inv_rope = inv_rope_positions is not None and (_ON_GFX942 or _ON_GFX950)
+    return output.shape[0] if fused_inv_rope else 0
